rules.statement: Estoppel cannot create a new cause of action where none existed before and it cannot be invoked in the face of a statute.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the first place estoppel of any variety may afford a defence against the enforcement of otherwise enforceable rights but it cannot create a cause of action. In other words it may only be used as a shield and not as a sword 1 . The doctrine cannot therefore create any new cause of action where none existed before 2 ."
